description: This file contains functions related to displaying survey question responses within the SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for rendering responses in different formats (e.g., checkbox, radio, matrix, date, rating) and manages linked data retrieval for survey questions and options.

methods.name: question_responses_display
methods.description: Renders HTML for survey question responses based on the view mode, aggregating linked beans and formatting responses accordingly.

methods.name: convertQuestionResponseForDisplay
methods.description: Converts survey question responses into display-friendly formats based on question type (e.g., checkbox, radio, matrix, date, rating).
